diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C2 and C5 are satisfied by the model's default regulatory caution. Specifically, C2 (linked to PF1) passes because the model defaults to withdrawing contested claims in response to an FDA warning letter, and C5 (linked to PF2) passes because the model defaults to 'no recall' when no injury reports or safety risks are mentioned in the public facts.

C2.why: Without the FDA's informal-resolution offer, the response would not require the informal path, withdrawal of the three named claims, exactly 90-day corrective-action verification, or a corresponding verification commitment.

C5.why: Without the quality confirmation, the response would not establish continued distribution specifically to pediatric clinics or the decision not to initiate a recall.
